name: 90005 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90005 (Los Angeles) has 224 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90005 (Los Angeles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90005 (Los Angeles) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
